<h3><span class="highlight">Develop the 3 skills</span> that the best managers have.</h3>
<p>
        Based on research from over the past 4+ years, we've found the best managers are great at 3 skills:
        </p>
<ol>
<li><strong>Trust:</strong>  If you don't build rapport as a leader, nothing moves forward.</li>
<li><strong>Honesty:</strong> If you don't speak the truth to your team, problems fester. </li>
<li><strong>Context:</strong> If you don't get everyone on the same page, confusion sets in.</li>
</ol>
